convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iStochastic indicators across multiple timeframes. Standard entry/exit rules with fixed SL/TP. No external .mqh libraries for trading logic. Multi-timeframe stochastic logic is straightforward to replicate in Python.

derived_values.used_by: Entry/exit threshold for long signals and short exits

other_exits: Close long when multi stochastic average crosses above overbought level
Close short when multi stochastic average crosses below oversold level

custom_logic_notes: The EA computes a Multi Stochastic value by averaging the %K values of iStochastic across 4 timeframes (current chart TF + 3 higher timeframes configurable via inputs). Entry uses the averaged stochastic crossing overbought/oversold thresholds. Signal reversal closes opposite positions before opening new ones. SL and TP are input parameters with default values but the primary exit mechanism is the stochastic signal reversal.
python_conversion_notes: Multi-timeframe stochastic averaging is straightforward: fetch stochastic %K for each configured timeframe using the same k_period/d_period/slowing, average them, then compare against overbought/oversold thresholds. Ensure M1 data is available to properly reconstruct higher timeframe bars. Position check before entry is standard. Signal reversal logic means close-then-open on direction change. No digit adjustment needed since SL/TP are specified in points via input parameters and applied via NormalizeDouble.
